rule: Several solid blue (1) rectangles sit on a black (0) canvas. No two touch, not even diagonally. Each holds single yellow (4) or magenta (6) cells. Output the exact crop of the rectangle with the strictly fewest special (non-blue) cells. Cells are counted individually, not as blobs.
scope: Construct separated blue rectangles with yellow/magenta special cells; crop the unique rectangle with the fewest individual special cells. Add count near-misses and blob-counting counterexamples.

authored_scope: Supported: canvas width and height sampled from 10..30, or set explicitly to 3..30 when feasible; 2..7 rectangles of 3..10 per side, which may touch the canvas border; winner special count 1..3; up to floor(area/3) specials per random rectangle, reaching the fixture density of 3 in a 3x3; isolated specials by default, sometimes touching specials, sometimes a blob-decoy runner-up; near-miss runner-ups with exactly one more special; random 4/6 colour mix. Explicit latent rectangles reconstruct the canonical fixtures. Deliberately not supported: tied minima, because the tie-break is unshown; zero-special rectangles; other background, main or special colours; non-rectangular shapes; scenes where black is not the majority colour.
authored_constraints: Rectangles are pairwise separated by at least one black cell, diagonals included.
Every rectangle lies inside the canvas.
Blue strictly outnumbers specials inside every rectangle, so the per-component dominant colour is 1.
Black is strictly the most frequent canvas colour. Random scenes cover strictly less than half the canvas.
The minimum special-cell count is unique. Explicit scenes with a tied minimum are rejected.
Special colours are in {4, 6}. Special offsets are distinct and lie inside their rectangle.
Geometry and offsets are non-bool integers. Bad explicit input raises ValueError.
Fixed canvases that cannot hold the requested rectangle count are rejected before sampling: 18n < W*H, 16n <= (W+1)(H+1), and one side >= 7.
All sampling loops are bounded: 400 scene attempts, 80 placements per box, 60 special placements.
